66enum class eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy : uint8_t {
67 NO_OVERRIDE = 0,
68 FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE1 = 1,
69 FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE2 = 2,
70};
71
72inline const char *
73unsupported_profile_disallow_policy_to_string(eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy policy)
74{
75 switch (policy) {
76 case eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::NO_OVERRIDE:
77 return "NO_OVERRIDE";
78 case eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE1:
79 return "FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE1";
80 case eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE2:
81 return "FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE2";
82 default:
83 return "UNKNOWN";
84 }
85}
86
87inline bool
88unsupported_profile_disallow_policy_from_config_value(uint8_t value,
89 eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy &policy)
90{
91 switch (value) {
92 case static_cast<uint8_t>(eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::NO_OVERRIDE):
93 policy = eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::NO_OVERRIDE;
94 return true;
95 case static_cast<uint8_t>(eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE1):
96 policy = eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE1;
97 return true;
98 case static_cast<uint8_t>(eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE2):
99 policy = eUnsupportedProfileDisallowPolicy::FORCE_DISALLOW_PROFILE2;
100 return true;
101 default:
102 return false;
103 }
104}
